description: The chart titled “Evaluation Based on Different Tasks” illustrates accuracy values for two evaluation tasks, with bars representing three labeled conditions (Base, RMU with Enhanced GCG, and RMU). The horizontal axis contains the task categories “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval,” shown in that left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to about 0.7, with regularly spaced tick marks at approximately 0.2 intervals (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6). For “MCQ Eval,” there is an orange Base bar reaching 0.644 (value printed above), and next to it a stacked bar composed of a pale yellow RMU segment up to 0.299 (value printed within/near the yellow portion) with a light green segment stacked above it up to a total height of 0.539, corresponding to RMU with Enhanced GCG (value printed above the full stacked height). For “Generation Eval,” the orange Base bar reaches 0.597, and the adjacent stacked bar has a pale yellow RMU segment up to 0.106 with a light green segment stacked above to a total height of 0.263 for RMU with Enhanced GCG. A legend centered below the plot maps orange to “Base,” light green to “RMU with Enhanced GCG,” and pale yellow to “RMU,” and the bars are not displayed as being sorted by value or otherwise visually emphasized beyond the numeric annotations.
